subject: Procurement staging heatmap & action plan — PO vs card vs marketplace
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Kim Larson <kim.larson@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement staging heatmap & next steps

Hi Kim,

Thanks again for meeting this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the procurement path we discussed:

What we covered
- Preferred commercial paths: PO (preferred by your ops), corporate card (fastest), or marketplace listing (longer-term).
- Key gating sequence: Legal review -> Security questionnaire -> Finance/commercial approval -> PO issuance.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
1) Legal review kickoff (owner: Orbit Legal)
2) Security questionnaire & evidence (owner: Orbit Security / Redwood provides SOC2 summary + DFD)
3) Finance verification & PO issuance (owner: Orbit Finance)
4) Contract signature / PO delivered

Target timeline we discussed
- Kickoff: this week (4/28)
- Legal & security: 1–2 weeks concurrent
- Finance/PO: 2–4 weeks after legal sign-off

Ask: Can you confirm (a) whether Orbit will go PO or card, (b) the procurement contact (name + email) we should loop in, and (c) an internal target date for PO issuance?

I attached a procurement staging heatmap with milestones and a first-draft MPA.

Attachments: redwood-procurement-heatmap.xlsx

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187

From: Kim Larson <kim.larson@orbithealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbithealth.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement staging heatmap & next steps

Priya — thanks for the note and clear summary.

Short answers:
- We intend to purchase via PO (preferred for vendor tracking). Card is only for small one-off tools.
- Procurement contact: procurement@orbithealth.com (cc'd here). Primary buyer is Nate Flores (nate.flores@orbithealth.com).
- Target PO issuance: we aim for 3–5 weeks, dependent on security questionnaire results.

The procurement team asked for the following artifacts to attach to our vendor packet:
- SOC 2 Type II summary
- Data flow diagram / high-level architecture
- Brief note on encryption & key management (KMS)

I've attached our vendor_vetting_template.docx so you can see what procurement will file.

Next step on our side: procurement will run vendor vetting once we have the SOC2 and DFD. I'll loop Nate on the next email.

Best,

Kim

Priya / Ben — quick internal note to confirm what we can provide and proposed owners/timing so we give Orbit a crisp packet:

Artifacts we can share immediately
- SOC 2 Type II summary (owner: Security team) — attached as s1-soc2-summary.pdf
- High-level data flow diagram (owner: Solutions Architecture) — attached as redwood-dataflow-2027.svg
- KMS + encryption note (owner: Security) — 1-paragraph ready in the MPA

Owners / suggested handoffs
- Security questionnaire responses: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com)
- Contract/legal clarifications: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.com)
- Pricing / SOW clarifications: Priya (me)

Suggested internal timeline (assuming Orbit starts vendor packet this week)
- Day 0 (4/28): Provide SOC2 + DFD + KMS note (we can deliver today)
- Day 3–7: Security completes questionnaire responses
- Day 7–14: Legal reviews T&Cs and flags redlines
- Day 14–28: Finance/Procurement issues PO (variable depending on Orbit cadence)

I'll build these into the MPA and send a version to Priya for external sharing. Recommend we include a single-sheet heatmap and an explicit contact table so Orbit can drop the packet into their vendor portal.

Attachments: s1-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-dataflow-2027.svg

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations (Contracts)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Kim Larson <kim.larson@orbithealth.com>, Nate Flores <nate.flores@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@orbithealth.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Updated mutual action plan & next steps (Orbit Health / Redwood)

Hi Kim / Nate — looping Nate per Kim's note. Hi Nate — great to e-meet you. Quick update and an attached refined mutual action plan (MPA) that includes the heatmap, owners, and an expected timeline based on our internal commitments.

What we attached
- Mutual Action Plan (mutual-action-plan-orbit-2027.docx) — includes: milestones, owners, deliverables, expected durations.
- SOC 2 Type II summary (already provided)
- Data flow diagram (already provided)

Key milestones (from MPA)
- 0–3 days: Redwood provides SOC2 summary, DFD, KMS note (done)
- 3–10 days: Orbit Security completes questionnaire
- 7–14 days: Orbit Legal reviews any T&C flags (parallel to security)
- 14–28 days: Orbit Finance/Procurement issues PO (target window; we understand this is dependent on your internal gating)

Ask / next steps
- Nate / procurement team: please confirm the internal PO target date and whether Orbit needs a formal SOW or line-item pricing in the vendor packet.
- Kim: please confirm if we should initiate a Marketplace evaluation (longer runway) in parallel or keep this strictly PO path for now.

We also created a DocuSign room for standard order forms if that accelerates signature once the PO is issued: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/abcd1234

If agreed, I'll mark the HubSpot deal RDW-7591 with the MPA and move the likelihood stage to "procurement".

Thanks all — happy to jump on a short follow-up call if that helps coordinate owners.

Best,

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0187
